Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - Mantri

Job Purpose

This role exists to design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Microsoft technologies, enabling the company to deliver reliable and high-performance financial solutions that support business growth and digital transformation.

Duties And Responsibilities

Major Activities carried out by the role

•  Major Activity 1
•  Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code under the guidance of senior team members and follow coding standards and best practices.
•  Support the development and maintenance of data access layers using Entity Framework, ADO.NET, and Dapper.
•   Contribute to the development and maintenance of microservices and microapps for scalable application development.
•  Use Git and Azure DevOps pipelines for source control, build management, and deployment activities
•  Major Activity 2
•  Participate in peer code reviews and learn from feedback shared by senior developers and team leads.
•  Support application performance improvement activities through efficient coding and optimization techniques.
•  Major Activity 3
•  
• Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and other Agile/Scrum ceremonies.
•   Provide regular updates on assigned tasks and ensure timely completion of development activities.
•  Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and development practices to enhance technical skills and contribute effectively to the team.

Key Decisions / Dimensions

•  Making decisions on validation logic, input sanitization, and security practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
•  Implementing effective error-handling mechanisms and deciding on logging strategies for easier debugging and monitoring.
•  Identifying bottlenecks and applying caching, asynchronous processing, or query optimization to enhance performance.

Major Challenges

•  The role involves working within tight deadlines while learning to deliver high-quality solutions. It requires adapting to new and evolving technologies, as well as gaining experience in handling moderately complex systems. It also involves developing ownership of assigned tasks end-to-end over time.

Required Qualifications And Experience

•  Qualifications
•  Should have strong knowledge and experience in Object Oriented Programming, Analysis and Design Concepts.
•  Should have extensive experience in product/application development using Microsoft stack.
•  Should have experience in developing applications using design principle/patterns and architecture design patterns like MVC and MVVM.
•  Should have knowledge in asynchronous programming practices using .Net Task Parallel concepts.
•  Should have experience in writing data access code using Microsoft Entity Framework.
•  Preference Experience in Financial Domain.
•  Work Experience

Experience should be between 2 to 3 years

•  Skills Keywords

Must-Have Skills: (2 yrs hands-on exp)

•  .NET Core
•  Angular
•  WebAPI
•  Microservices
•  Strong OOPs concepts and architectural design knowledge
•  Experience with Entity Framework

Good-to-Have Skills

•  jQuery
•  Microsoft Azure

Preferred Domain Experience

•  Financial Services / Banking / Broking
